sources.note: Main homepage. Claims 92,000+ medical professionals, $10B+ claims processed. Lists core products: practice management, EHR, billing, RCM services, patient engagement, telehealth.

ONC certification page. Describes product as 'cloud based full suite of Practice Management, Certified EHR, Portal, Kiosk, and Online Review Management system.' Lists required third-party integrations (NewCropRx, EMRDirect, HelloHealth). Includes real-world testing results 2022-2025.
EHR product page. Details clinical features: single-screen charting, customizable templates, lab integration (Labcorp, Quest), e-prescribing, clinical dashboards, task management, 30+ EMR templates.
Practice management page. Describes scheduling, eligibility verification, billing/claims dashboard, collections manager, charge validation, credit card processing, 140 reports, patient registration.
Patient portal page. Online scheduling, digital check-in, records access, telehealth integration.

Patient engagement page (powered by HelloHealth). Two-way patient chat, broadcast messaging, customizable reminders, ePayments, patient satisfaction surveys, prescription refill requests, labs/records access.

FreeChiro EMR page. Minimal content — describes itself as 'Silicon Valley founded Technology Company dedicated to providing the chiropractic community with awesome software.' Offers free one-month trial.

ChiroMonkey review of FreeChiro. Confirms FreeChiro is a product of PracticeSuite Inc. Free base tier, $149/month paid tier. Criticizes interface as 'poorly designed, non-intuitive and archaic.' Notes it serves 55 specialties and 'fails to meet the specific needs of chiropractors' for reporting. 0 user reviews.
EMRSystems.net review. 4/5 stars from 5 reviews. Users praise charting flexibility and customer support. Concerns about initial training time and frequent updates. Base price listed at $123/month.
Software Finder listing. General features overview and pricing information for PracticeSuite.
Capterra listing for PracticeSuite. Page returned 403 error — could not access reviews.
MedicalRecords.com FreeChiro listing. Page content was mostly technical markup with minimal product information.
